about.heroSubtitle: Mentorium was founded on a simple idea: access to knowledge shouldn't depend on where you were born or how much money you have.
about.missionTitle: Closing the skills gap, one course at a time
about.missionBody1: Mentorium was founded on the belief that learning from real practitioners is the best way to master a new skill.
about.missionBody2: We partner with the best Georgian educators to create content that's practical and genuinely useful in the real world.
about.value1Desc: Education should be available to everyone, regardless of geography or income.
about.value2Desc: Every course is built around real-world application. We measure success by what you can do after.
about.value3Desc: Our mentors are co-creators. We share revenue fairly and invest in their growth.
about.value4Desc: We review course content regularly and work with mentors to keep everything current.
about.value5Desc: Learning is social. Our platform is built to foster discussion and mentorship.
about.value6Desc: We obsess over the small things: video quality, page speed, how easy it is to find the right course.
about.finalCtaSubtitle: Join thousands of learners already building new skills on Mentorium.
